name: Langflow
description: Visual framework for building multi-agent AI applications with drag-and-drop components and Python-based customization.

env.label: Auto Login
env.description: Enable automatic login without authentication (set to false to require login)

env.label: Admin Username
env.description: Superuser username (used when auto login is disabled)

env.label: Admin Password
env.description: Superuser password (used when auto login is disabled)

env.label: Secret Key
env.description: Secret key for encrypting sensitive data and signing tokens

env.label: OpenAI API Key
env.description: OpenAI API key; exposed as a global variable in flows and can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: Anthropic API Key
env.description: Anthropic API key; exposed as a global variable in flows and can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: Google AI API Key
env.description: Google AI / Gemini API key; exposed as a global variable in flows and can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: Groq API Key
env.description: Groq API key; exposed as a global variable in flows and can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: Mistral API Key
env.description: Mistral API key; exposed as a global variable in flows and can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: Database URL
env.description: Database connection URL (defaults to local SQLite; use postgresql:// for production)

env.label: Config Directory
env.description: Directory for Langflow configuration and data storage
